d:
Bhojpuri abhinetri nilam giri rajdhani patna ke eyarport pahunch gaee hain. jankari ke anusar, ve vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shahi shadi men shamil hone ke lie pahunchi hain.
Shivangi ki shahi shadi men shamil hone patna pahunchin nilam giri
Anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi ko lekar chal rahe aayojnon ke bich mehmanon aur kalakaron ke pahunchne ka daur jari hai. isi kari men bhojpuri ektres nilam giri ke patna aagman ko lekar phains aur sthaniy logon men khasi charcha hai. is vidiyo men dekhie patna eyarport pahunchin nilam giri aur shivangi ki shadi se juri yah apdeta.
